human_name: Y chromosome palindrome P1 (AZFc, DAZ cluster)

GRCh38.note: Approximate — AZFc region per Navarro-Costa 2010 (PMC2910558) ~23-26.8 Mb in hg38; assembly coords approximate due to ampliconic mosaic content. Rhie 2023 reports P1-P3 are discordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y due to assembly errors in GRCh38.

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0/Y v1 — concatenation of P1-left-arm (24167431-25503792, 1336361 bp) and P1-right-arm (25787351-27122770, 1335419 bp); spacer 25503792-25787351 (~283 kb). Source: chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl)

copy_count_typical: 2 arms (palindromic) + internal P1.1/P1.2 24 kb minipalindromes; 4 DAZ + 2 CDY + 2 BPY2 amplicons
architecture_note: Largest known mammalian palindrome (~2.9 Mb total span). Contains two internal 24 kb mini-palindromes P1.1 and P1.2, each 9.9 kb arm + 3.9 kb spacer (Skaletsky 2003). >80% of P1 is directly related to P2, P3, P5 sequence via ampliconic mosaic (Rhie 2023, Repping 2002).

internal_minipalindromes.note: 92 kb sequence block in P1.2 is recombination substrate for AZFb (P5/proximal-P1) deletions

diagnostic_features.azf_region: AZFc (distal P1 + P2); proximal P1 also contributes to P5/proximal-P1 AZFb deletions

clinical_deletion_products.name: b2/b4 deletion
clinical_deletion_products.mechanism: NAHR between b2 and b4 amplicons within P1

primary.note: Arm-to-arm identity 99.97% means most 31-mers are shared between arms — chain disambiguation requires anchoring to spacer + flanking unique sequence. k=31, mm=1 because expected per-arm divergence is <0.05% (~1 SNP per 2 kb).

fallback_chain.name: spacer_anchor
fallback_chain.trigger: primary returns ambiguous chains across both arms
fallback_chain.rationale: P1 spacer (~283 kb) is unique within P1; anchor chain there to disambiguate arm-of-origin

fallback_chain.name: amplicon_unit_chain
fallback_chain.rationale: Use DAZ-specific PSVs (DAZ1/2/3/4 differ by ~30 SNPs each; Discrimination 2016 PMC5056753)

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.rationale: report all DAZ copies (DAZ1+2 on left arm, DAZ3+4 on right arm) when read uniqueness exhausted

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: b2/b4, gr/gr, b1/b3 deletions create chimeric amplicons not present in canonical reference

primary_sources.note: Skaletsky H et al., Nature. The male-specific region of the human Y chromosome is a mosaic of discrete sequence classes. Table 3: P1 arm 1450 kb, spacer 2.1 kb, identity 99.97%, total 2902 kb. Defines palindrome nomenclature.
Repping S et al., AJHG. Recombination between palindromes P5 and P1 on the human Y chromosome causes massive deletions and spermatogenic failure. AZFb mechanism.
Kuroda-Kawaguchi T et al., Nat Genet. AZFc region 229 kb direct-repeat NAHR products.
Rhie A et al., Nature. The complete sequence of a human Y chromosome. T2T-Y (HG002). P1-P3 are discordant between GRCh38-Y and T2T-Y due to GRCh38 assembly errors.

supporting_databases: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chm13v2.0Y_inverted_repeats_v1.bed (marbl/CHM13 GitHub, s3://human-pangenomics/T2T/CHM13/assemblies/annotation/) — authoritative T2T coordinates
GRCh38 chrY (NCBI) — known to contain assembly errors in P1-P3 per Rhie 2023
